152210.overview:
Step into the world of high fashion! As young designer Grace Styles, you’ll lead the team at the Satisfashion Design House on a journey to the top of the fashion industry. Create trends with the latest fashions, hippest models and funkiest makeup. Show off your hot new looks on runways across the globe and set the fashion world on fire! With each innovative new trend you create you’ll help elevate Satisfashion to the top of the industry!

Gameplay:

• See the World: Show off your collection and designs at exotic locations spanning 60 levels set at the hippest locations around the globe.
• She’s Got the Look: Each fashion show has a theme. Choose the clothing and makeup that best fits the fashion scenario to impress the buyers. Show off your hottest outfits with the all-new Lookbook Feature.
• Dress Up Mode: The world of high fashion can be demanding, but Dress Up Mode isn’t. Experiement with new looks and makeup styles in this untimed free-play mode.
• Make it Work: Design your own clothing to wow buyers on the runway! Thousands of design possibilities let players put a personal twist on in-game clothing!

152248.overview: Invite your friends to the coolest sleepover party ever with Sleepover Party on Wii! Sleepover Party is the interactive video game that lets you plan and host fun-filled overnight parties with your best friends. With the help of your virtual hostess Aimee, you can plan your party, choose your party theme, build your guest list, create shopping lists, and more. Then have a blast at your very own sleepover party as you play a variety of fun games and activities.

152310.overview:
Shaun White Snowboarding: Road Trip takes the action-sports genre to a whole new level. For the first-time ever, feel the rocky weight of the mountain push up against your toes in your very own living room, ­with the revolutionary Wii Balance Board. Whether you’re coasting down bunny slopes or carving through black diamonds, don’t expect to survive this wild ride alone – you will need the support of an entourage and friends to make it down this mountain.

Developed in close collaboration with Olympic Gold Medalist Shaun White – the most successful snowboarder in the history of the sport – Shaun White Snowboarding is set to redefine the action-sports genre. 

Target Limited Edition includes exclusive mountain, extra challenges and more!

152606.overview:
NEO is the first Super Robot Wars title to appear on the Nintendo Wii. NEO carries on from Super Robot Wars GC and Super Robot Wars XO by using 3D models for the battle animations, rather than the standard 2D sprite animation which the Super Robot Wars series is known for. NEO also stands out as the many anime series featured were shows aimed at a younger audience, three of the titles making a debut: Haō Taikei Ryū Knight, NG Knight Lamune & 40 and Shippū! Iron Leaguer originated in the early-to-mid-90s "chibi robo" style of robot anime marketed to children, in which the robots were presented with super-deformed proportions. Most of the Eldran series also make their first appearance in this game.
Super Robot Wars NEO introduces several new gameplay features to the series and a new battle system.

152967.overview:
Swords pits you against the best of the best from past, present, and future in the ultimate sword fighting contest. This is what you’ve trained for, this is your destiny. Make your way from the dojo to the Final Showdown, and prove that you are the greatest swordsman of all time!

Features
• The Wii Remote, with Wii Motion Plus, is your ultimate weapon!
– Experience the realism of 1:1 sword movement, real time blocking, and advanced combos!
• Earn new swords with every victory, each with its own unique abilities.
• Travel through time and space, compete in challenging tournaments, and face-off against the masters of each style in brutal boss battles.
• Challenge a friend or play together in a variety of training drills.
• Increase your skills and learn new combos in mini game challenges, like carving, sparring, blocking, and even battling a horde of zombies!
• Battle against 8 unique characters, each with a distinct look and home arena that represents their fighting styles:
– Sensei Musashi: Your sensei, and adopted father. He will prepare you for the tournament.
– Rognir: This giant Viking chieftain swings a big sword and is looking to take your head off. Be alert, and quick!
– Lancelot: Sir Lancelot is a brave knight of the round table. Using a broadsword and shield, his only weakness is his ritualized fighting style.
– Princess Aisha, the Generous: Aisha is a swift and dangerous foe. Catch her when she changes direction and exploit this short window of vulnerability.
– Captain Jack Rackham: A clever and nimble opponent, Captain Jack is a first class scoundrel. Watch out for his cheating ways and his bag of blinding sand.
– Keiko Anamura: This flirtatious lady will lure you in with compassion before stabbing you in the back. Her temper is her greatest strength, and also her weakness…
– Razor: The last of the Jumandi hunter droids, Razor comes from the distant future. Armed with laser swords and capable of incredible acrobatic moves, Razor almost seems undefeatable…
– Mysterious final combatant: who will it be?

153216.overview:
Kid Adventures: Sky Captain includes 40 exhilarating missions from sky racing, stunt flying, target shooting and treasure hunting. 

Players will also have the option of inviting a friend to the cockpit and playing cooperatively in any of the missions or head-to-head in multiplayer mode and can unlock several flying machines including a jet plane and UFO. Kid Adventures: Sky Captain provides the chance for players to improve their flight skills, scores and rank, and is fun for the entire family to enjoy!

154562.overview: This breakout game is the similar to the other breakout games on other platforms. Use the board below to bounce the dropped ball back and knock off the bricks. The Wii's unique gameplay mode is slightly more. People who are more nostalgic can give it a try.

155672.overview:
SpongeBob SquigglePants is an action video game based on the SpongeBob SquarePants television series, developed by WayForward Technologies and published by THQ. The game was first announced on March 23, 2011 and was released for Wii in North America on April 12, 2011, April 14, 2011 in Australia, and in Europe on April 15, 2011. The Nintendo 3DS version was released on May 17, 2011 in North America and in Europe on May 27, 2011. It is the fourth game to use the uDraw GameTablet accessory and borrows its concept from the WarioWare series, consisting of a series of minigames. SpongeBob SquigglePants also features appearances from Patchy the Pirate, the president of the SpongeBob fan club, as its live-action host.

SpongeBob SquigglePants consists of over 100 mini-games (or Nanogames) which require using the uDraw GameTablet. Each game has a time limit of a few seconds and can only be tried five times before failing. Examples include "Flying Disc of the Deep", where the player flicks the stylus to toss a flying disc to Larry the Lobster; "That Takes the Spongecake", where the player tilts the tablet to help SpongeBob blow out all the birthday cake candles; and "A Bridge Abridged", where the player draws a quick line between two cliffs to create a bridge for Plankton to cross and grab his coveted Krabby Patty, which it's mini-games borrows its concept from the WarioWare series.

SpongeBob SquigglePants also features appearances from Patchy the Pirate, the president of the SpongeBob fan club, as its live-action host. Patchy guides players through the game and makes surprise appearances and interacts with players as they play the Nanogames. SpongeBob SquigglePants also lets players digitally draw, paint and color with a free-form drawing function, or choose from several SpongeBob-themed stamps. With the uDraw's exclusive ability to export art to the Wii system's SD card slot, players can also put their drawings aworthy of a place in Patchy's own collection of SpongeBob art – or their own refrigerator. The SD card capability also makes it possible to share artwork with friends via e-mail or save it to computer desktops.

155902.overview:
Super Sentai Battle: Ranger Cross is a video game developed by Paon and published by Bandai Namco Games Inc. in September of 2011, as part of the 35th anniversary celebration of Super Sentai. The game follows a musou-style formula in which you are pitted against hordes of enemies on a playing field and must defeat all enemies to advance, with battles in the mechas interspersed here and there. This game is technically a Gokaiger game, but as they are not the only ones you can play as, this is why the game is called Super Sentai Battle and not Kaizoku Sentai Gokaiger.

The teams you can play as are:

Kaizoku Sentai Gokaiger (2011)
Samurai Sentai Shinkenger (2009)
Tensou Sentai Goseiger (2010)
Engine Sentai Go-Onger (2008)
Himitsu Sentai Goranger (1975-1976)
This would be the first time a non-Heisei era team would be playable in any Super Sentai game that was not a crossover with other franchises, as Goranger was the first season of Super Sentai. The other teams up to Go-Onger make appearances through the Gokai keys, but they are an extension of the Gokaiger team, and therefore are not truly playable.

156392.overview: Put your friends in the Hot Seat and get answers to all the questions you've been dying to ask! The unique vocal calibration software lets you know whether or not your friends are telling the truth! Play Truth or Lies and discover what secrets are waiting to be revealed!

163727.overview:
In Super Mario Galaxy 2, Mario is once again called upon to rescue his friend, Princess Peach. This time, he teams up with Yoshi and travels across the universe in Starship Mario, a flying vessel shaped like Mario’s head!

Terrific transformations - Certain mushrooms can transform Mario, giving him unique abilities. There are also other treats that can transform Yoshi!
• Rock Mario - Roll like crazy and break stuff.
• Fire Mario - Blast powerful fireballs for a limited time.
• Cloud Mario - Create up to three clouds to stand on.
• Dash Yoshi - A spicy Dash Pepper makes Yoshi sprint for a short time.
• Blimp Yoshi - Eating a Blimp Fruit will make Yoshi blow up like a balloon, giving Mario a brief ride up into the air.
• Bulb Yoshi - A Bulb Berry can make Yoshi light up the surrounding area, revealing invisible platforms.

172477.overview: Train with an Olympic champion in this game where you can experience the thrills of professional gymnastics! Shawn Johnson Gymnastics lets you learn with one of the best, 2008 gold- and silver-medal winner Shawn Johnson. Use your Wii Remote and Nunchuk to perform on the balance beam, vault, uneven bars, and floor. Shawn's voice offers guidance and inspiration, plus motivation to do well. Nail a routine and you'll unlock some of Shawn's best performances. Use the built-in choreography editor to design your own judge-wowing routines. Up to eight players can compete together, and the game is compatible with the Wii Balance Board for added realism.

178466.overview:
SD Gundam: Scad Hammers is a Gundam title for the Wii in which players control a mech unit equipped with a giant hammer. It has been released in Japan. The game is illustrated by Kunio Okawara.

The game is a comedic retelling of the original series. Tem Ray has finally finished the RX-78-2 Gundam, but much to the shock of General Revil, the only weapon it had was the Gundam Hammer and its variants. When Zeon forces attacked Side 7, Amuro Ray was forced to become the test pilot of the Gundam by his father.

178467.overview:
Three Soul Eater video games were produced. The first, Soul Eater: Monotone Princess, is an action-adventure video game exclusively for the Wii and developed by Square Enix with Bones. It was released on September 25, 2008 in Japan. Two characters that appear in the game, Grimoire and Ponera, are original characters designed by author Atsushi Ōkubo; Ponera is the titular Monotone Princess and Grimoire is known as Noah in the manga.

The player controls a Meister, either Maka, Black Star or Death the Kid, accompanied by their Weapon partner to fight those masked creatures. The game is separated in a number of missions leading to a boss fight. A number of foes, displayed in the lower-right corner, must be found and defeated in each stage. While exploring, the Weapon follows the Meister in human form, and changes into a weapon when enemies are encountered. Health is replenished by sun icons found by breaking crates lying around during exploration phases. Once the target number of defeated foes is reached, the level is cleared, and the player is rated on clear time, damage taken, number of hits and level bonus. The next mission can then be selected.

181930.overview:
Crayon Shin-chan: Strongest Family in Kasukabe Wii King is a videogame developed and published for the Nintendo Wii based upon the manga and anime series Crayon Shin-chan. The game was released in Spain on April 25, 2008 by 505 Games as Shin Chan: Las Nuevas Aventuras para Wii. This game was a launch title for the Wii in Japan and Spain only.

The game consists of a series of mini-games integrated into the world of Shin-chan.

181934.overview:
Enjoy "Samurai Warriors 3"! New character "Garasha" appears! Masanori Fukushima and Aya Gozen join the playable battle! The new story of 10 people will further color the Sengoku picture scroll! 

Full of elements that you can play to the fullest
● 10 new stories unfold!
●Your battle becomes history!
- Compete with players from all over the country for records! [Test your skills]
Wi-Fi network for cooperative play! [Murasame Castle Mode] 

The system has also been greatly enhanced, including new weapon enhancements. All 40 characters and all stories can be played with "SAMURAI WARRIORS 3 Gekishoden" + "SAMURAI WARRIORS 3"!

181935.overview: Summer Challenge: Athletics Tournament offers a fast-paced sports entertainment experience for the enthusiast and the entire family. Challenge the world's best athletes in 20 disciplines playing in single or multi player game modes. Bring the excitement of major competitions into your living room with photo realistic stadiums and atmospheric sound. Summer Challenge includes the most popular and diverse sports with up to four players in head to head competition or challenge your skill in single player career mode. Compare your performance against the rest of the world via online leader boards.

181936.overview: Suzumiya Haruhi no Gekidō is the third game in the series of novels centering around the girl by the name of Haruhi Suzumiya, based off of comics followed by anime adaptation. The core of the gameplay in this game in the series is dancing. The story consists of typical visual novel dialogues, followed by a three-girl dancing consisting of quick-time events. After each dance, you are given a score based on your performance, and are able to retry it if you are aiming for a higher score than that already earned.

181937.overview:
Suzumiya Haruhi no Heiretsu is the fourth game in the series centering around a high-school girl, Suzumiya Haruhi, based on manga and anime. Released only a couple of months after Suzumiya Haruhi no Gekidō, this game continues the story but loses the rhythm based games and plays almost entirely as a visual novel game. Unlike a typical visual novel with static backgrounds and fixed character poses, the game uses 3D backgrounds and dynamic characters with full voice-acting and lip-syncing.

The story takes place during summer vacation aboard the luxury cruise ship Oberon. The same day repeats over and over again, and by using recollections of events and actions encountered during previous time loops, the player can change the story. Aside from visual novel interface, the player has certain luxury to search around each scene and interact with objects, talk to other characters and unlock new topics key to the story unfolding. Certain event scenes contain "interrupt" mark which allows the player to react for a brief amount of time which launches an additional action or retrieves certain object for you, otherwise the default event scene if the interruption is not initiated in time.

184493.overview: Red Baron, from the freedom- and peace-loving nation of birds, Bird Land, faces off in the skies with his rival Blue Max in this side-scrolling shooting game. Defeat the many enemies that await you as you complete your mission, using moves like the loop-the-loop to shoot down enemies from behind. Fly low to pick up bombs placed in the stage and drop them on command posts, warships or other designated targets to destroy them. Then land safely at base to proceed to the next mission. Beware of enemy fire, though-it will cause you to crash, unless you're able to recover by rapidly pressing the buttons. You can even play with a second person and fly simultaneously, sometimes helping each other and other times competing against each other. Prepare yourself and take to the skies, but make sure that the catchy background music (which became an instant classic when this game was originally released) doesn't distract you from your goal.

185011.overview:
The Wii version include all of the currently released content and feature updates, including the Mogul Update, the Full Tank Update, and the many other little tweaks, improvements and optimizations that went into the game post-launch.

It will also allow you to experience the game in the most retro way possible... in 4:3 on your old CRT televisions.

The Wii version supports both 50hz and 60hz, and both NTSC and PAL output. It supports the Wii Remote (with shake!), Wii Classic Controller, Wii Classic Controller Pro, and GameCube Controller.

190876.overview:
SD Gundam Gashapon Wars (SDガンダム ガシャポンウォーズ) is a simulation game where you can organize your original units with your favorite mobile suits and share points on the map in the form of a camp.

The recorded modes include a one-player mode with a variety of ways to play, a "survival mode" where all participants are enemies, a "100 question battle" that clears the mission, and an action RPG-like “dangerous dungeons” mode. In addition, it has a mode that allows up to 4 players to play. Over 40 types of fields are recorded as battle stages. Each time you turn on the power, a new main map appears at random, so you can enjoy the game with a fresh feeling every time. More than 150 types of large and small types of MS appear. Some MSs can be deformed or fly. You can also collect them, and you can enjoy the MSs you get at the gallery.

The battle starts when MSs collide. In the battle scene, elements of the action game are also included. In addition to the strategy-oriented fighting method that advantageously develops the battle station based on the number and compatibility of MSs, the enemy units are operated by themselves by operating a small number of powerful MSs that can be annihilated.

190882.overview:
SD Gundam G Generation Wars, which is based on the "Gundam" series, gathers various Gundam works from generation to generation! From works set in the universe century to "Mobile Suit Gundam SEED" and "Mobile Suit Gundam 00", more than 30 works are included, appealing to a wide range of Gundam fans.

Not only can you relive the original episode as before, but the activation of the new system "Wars Break" causes unpredictable development at all. By satisfying the condition of "Wars Trigger", you can enjoy an if story where a character of 08 platoon intervenes in First Gundam and turns into a war. More than 700 units appear. The number of characters including general soldiers is over 700.

190884.overview:
Challenge difficult and good questions with the whole family.
You can enjoy the whole family in a battle quiz format.
Carefully selected Japanese, math, science, social, and Chinese characters, calculations, and graphic questions from 10 successive titles, and the number of recorded questions is 24,000, including new works.
You can use the Nintendo DS series main unit as a controller using wireless communication. If you use the Nintendo DS series main unit, you can write and answer Chinese character problems and answer calculation problems by entering numbers, so the range of fun will expand.
You can enjoy it with your family as if you were attending a quiz show on TV.

190929.overview:
Shanghai is the name Activision gave to series of simple matching games featuring patterns of stacked mahjong tiles on the Apple Macintosh and later Wintel PCs (other companies have sold the same game with various other names; the game is generically known as "mahjong solitaire" or "mahjong" though it has nothing to do with actual mahjong outside of using mahjong tiles). Sunsoft of Japan licensed the name for use in Japan and put out a series of arcade games as well as home versions which have been released for nearly every handheld and console in existence. Like those other SunSoft games, Shanghai Wii is presently only available in Japan, but don't let that stop you from enjoying this modern classic.

The rules are pretty straightforward: play through a linear series of board layouts composed of Mahjong tiles stacked in 3D patterns with the goal being the removal of all tiles in matching pairs from the playfield. Tiles are considered removable by having no tiles on top of them or touching left or right sides. In addition to two versions of this basic game there are four variant single-player games and four multi-player games.

190931.overview:
Compilation consisting 11 classic table games: "Mahjong", "Shogi", "Go", "Reversi", "Gomoku", "Koi-Koi", "Hana-awase", "Daifugō", "Sevens", "Concentration" and "Solitaire".

It includes two levels of difficulty for game and additional "quiz mode".

190932.overview: Simple Wii Series Vol. 1: The Minna de Kart Race (SIMPLE Wiiシリーズ Vol.1 THE みんなでカート・レース) is the first of D3's "Simple Series" launched on the Japanese market for the Wii platform. A kart racer similar to the Mario Racing series. This game not only supports split-screen four-player competition, but also supports global competition through Nintendo Wi-Fi Connection.

190933.overview:
Simple Wii Series Vol. 2: The Minna de Bass Tsuri Taikai (SIMPLE Wiiシリーズ Vol.2 THE みんなでバス釣り大会) is the second work of the "Simple Wii Series", the operation of the game is optimized according to the unique operation mode of the Wii, making fishing easier. The player only needs to swing the Wiimote according to the arrow on the right side of the screen to pull the fish, and then use the controller to turn the fish out of the water!

There is a ranking via Nintendo Wi-Fi Connection. You can compare the fish that you catch with other players.

190934.overview: Simple Wii Series Vol. 3: Ason de Wakaru - The Party Casino (SIMPLE Wiiシリーズ Vol.3 遊んで覚える THE パーティー・カジノ) is the third work of "Simple Wii Series", a casino game with five popular games, such as: "21" and "Poker". The biggest feature of this game is the use of NDS and Wii communication functions. In the game, you can use NDS to play poker games, so that your cards are not bound to be seen by opponents! The game also provides global battle through Nintendo's Wi-Fi Connection.

190935.overview:
Simple Wii Series Vol. 4: The DokoDemo Asoberu - The Shooting Action (SIMPLE WiiシリーズVol.4 THEシューティング･アクション) is a shoot'um up game. The player uses the left joystick to control the character movement in the game, and the right joystick controls the aiming. And shooting direction. Although the gameplay is somewhat similar to Geometry Warfare, this game adds a "power boosting system" and a "special attack" that consumes energy, which makes the game fun.

The game's mode is also rich, players can play one-on-one "single-hand mode" with the computer or "match mode" between friends and up to four people. In addition, you can use Wi-Fi Connection to conduct online battles around the world.

190936.overview: Simple Wii Series Vol. 6: The Wai Wai Combat (SIMPLE Wiiシリーズ Vol.6 THE ワイワイ・コンバット) is an action shooting game that, no matter what, people can play. There are three kinds of scenes available for the game. Players can play a match between up to six people through Nintendo's wireless global network, using weapons of all abilities and competing for the first place!

193521.overview: Project Plus is a community driven patch for Project M that strives to invigorate the Project M experience with further balances the roster, fixes lingering 3.6 bugs, adjusts movesets to be more fun to play with and against, introduces new gameplay mechanics to Project M, and includes new features such as those created by the Legacy TE team for Legacy TE 2.5.

197040.overview: This enhanced version of Romance of the Three Kingdoms XI includes several new additions over the original release: six new scenarios, more than 30 new events, 50 new officers, additional training options for officers, and an officer edit mode.

197048.overview: Sugoro Chronicle: Migite ni Ken o Hidarite ni Saikoro o (スゴロクロニクル 〜右手に剣を左手にサイコロを〜) is a board game which was released in Japan in 2008.

200447.overview: The Studio 100: Play Island (or Het Studio 100 Speeleiland) is a collection of games based around popular characters such as Studio 100's K3, Kells, Maja the bee and Amika. The game can be played by everyone together in the same style as the immensely popular WiiSports. Whether played by children, children with one parent, or with your grandmother, everyone has fun. In short, a true party game!

200501.overview:
Available only in Japan and Australia, this special edition of Super Mario Bros. on Virtual Console came pre-installed on the red Wii console bundles released on November 11, 2010. Super Mario Brothers 25th Anniversary Edition introduced two changes: The "?" on each Question Block was replaced with a "25," and the copyright date on the title screen was changed from "1985" to "1985-2010."

Though Nintendo's Japanese website called the game "Super Mario Brothers 25th Anniversary Edition," one of their screenshots showed an alternate title of "25th Anniversary SUPER MARIO BROS." on the Wii Channel info screen.

200559.overview:
Mario, Luigi, Toadette, and Toad set out to collect Green Stars across the Leaf Kingdom to defeat the invading Bowser and his minions! 

This hack will feature custom tilesets created by the community, several of which by joietyfull64, and a few tileset edits of my own, custom music remixed from files acquired from VGMusic.com and other sources, in Garageband/Logic Pro X, custom backgrounds, several also by joietyfull64, and a few background edits of my own, retextured elements, and custom world maps along with new themes. In addition, there is a hidden (and sometimes not-so-hidden) Luigi in every level.

200586.overview: Sengoku Basara 2 Heroes: Double Pack comes with Sengoku Basara 2 and Sengoku Basara 2 Heroes. The game sparked a major boom in tourism to the hometown of Katakura Kojūrō, Shiroishi City.

209042.overview: Sonic Riders Regravitified is a mod of Sonic Riders Zero Gravity that attempts to fix the game by making it faster, adding new mechanics, and rebalance and redesign the gears for competitive play.

209527.overview:
After the books and the TV series, here's the videogame!

This adventure game will allow the players to meet all the characters who made the success of the series, but also gives them the opportunity to realize their greatest dream of becoming a member of The Saddle Club!

209528.overview:
Horse games series Springdale, is a brand new series of games for you who love horses, mysteries, tasks and not least riding.
When a ship has run aground and it has started to leak oil, you will be asked to move out immediately. An oil spill always involves a disaster for both humans and animals. Can you find the crew and can the oil-damaged birds be rescued?

The beach landscape offers wonderful rides and obstacle courses. When you want to practice jumping, you can put together your own course!
You will also have the opportunity to test your horse knowledge by answering questions. Now you have to show what you are capable of!

• Action-packed riding experience
• Hestequiz
• Navigate with HippoTechen
• Build your own springboard
• Beach environment
• Ride on narrow bridges

212266.overview:
The SNES Mario mega-adventure jumps onto Virtual Console!

During a vacation in Dinosaur Land, Princess Toadstool gets kidnapped, and a spell is cast on the inhabitants of the island. When they stumble upon Yoshi, a young dinosaur, Mario and Luigi learn that Bowser is responsible for the terrible misdeeds. Now, all Yoshis are trapped in magical eggs that Bowser has hidden throughout seven castles. Many hidden paths aid Mario in making his way to Bowser's castle, completing 74 areas, and finding all 96 exits. Discover items, including a feather that gives Mario a cape that allows him to fly or a flower that shoots fireballs, in layers upon layers of 2-D scrolling landscapes. You can even ride Yoshi and swallow your enemies!

212667.overview: In the peaceful country of Transylvania, there is a legend of an evil castle and its master, the Prince of Darkness, Dracula. Once every hundred years, the powers of good mysteriously weaken, and evil attempts to resurrect Dracula. It's up to the Belmont clan to take up the eternal fight against the vampire. Players take on the role of Simon Belmont, armed with the legendary whip, Vampire Killer, to defeat Dracula and his evil minions. Luckily, Simon has many additional weapons at his disposal, including axes, holy water, crosses, knives and even a magical stopwatch that can stop the flow of time for a spell. Simon must travel through 11 stages, beginning in the countryside, to reach Dracula's Castle, all the while overcoming perilous traps and hideous monsters. Only the power of the Belmonts can quell the looming darkness.

213149.overview:
This collector's box contains:

    SD Gundam G Generation World
    The DVD Portrait of the Red: Char to Frontal Special Edition. This video presentation features Shūichi Ikeda recounting the story of the character he's lent his voice to for 40 years: Char Aznable. This special edition DVD also includes an interview.
    Shūichi Ikeda's script for Portrait of the Red.

213316.overview:
Sonic Colors HD/DX is a bundle of original modifications to the original (wii) Sonic Colors on a modified version of the Dolphin Emulator, with the goal of bringing the game up to modern graphics standards.

This mod aims to be more faithful to the original design than Sonic Colors: Ultimate, while containing fewer glitches.

Features:
- Easy One-Click install script
- Preconfigured for 16:9, FHD to 4kHD, 60fps, Fast Loading, Unleashed/Gens control map
- Original, high-poly Sonic model with improved shading
- Original, high-poly model for most stage objects (rings, wisp capsules, springs, etc)
- Fixed and improved bloom (Original bloom removed from stages and replaced with a post process shader)
- Improved unleashed-inspired color grading
- Improved lighting
- HD UI textures (thanks to triforce141 for letting me use his upscales!)
- HD textures for objects and enemies (some by triforce141, some original)
- 60fps fix for Aquarium Park Act 1
- Depth of Field Effect
- Restored stages to originally intended order

217618.overview: Super Smash Bros. Universe is a non-profit fan-game for Brawl by TheOfficialCherrim of the Super Smash Bros. Series.  It has many characters from all four Smash games, with additions to newcomers. It's current version is v2.6.1. This game, similar to Super Smash Bros.  for Wii U, supports 8-player Smash, but can go to an extent of 12-player Smash. It was developed by TheOfficialCherrim, Fade Ammo, Jack Arnett, and Lewis Edgecombe.

441337.overview: In L'esprit du Loup (aka Spirit of the Wolf) expand your knowledge about ecology with Nicolas Vanier, veteran explorer of the North Pole, who will guide you through an incredible journey of initiation in the understanding and protection of the environment.

448095.overview:
Mario and Luigi can now take on the Galaxy together!

Released by Mr. Brocoli, creator of the Super Mario Sunshine Multiplayer hack, this hack allows two players to play Super Mario Galaxy as a splitscreen adventure.

448321.overview:
In this business simulation game, players take on the role of Shawn and his monkey sidekick, Tam, as they build and maintain space stations. The game also features 30 other characters. It features a level-based system, where gamers have to complete a set of mission objectives—including "light puzzle solving"—to progress to the next stage and further expand their empire.

The game lets players use the motion sensing of the Wii Remote to create gravity points and interact with objects in the environment, as well as undertaking tasks such as catching asteroids to stop them from smashing into the space station and lobbing cannonballs at space pirates. In addition to a single player mode, there is also a multiplayer mode and co-op play elements.

Space Station Tycoon was a video game to be released in for the Wii developed by Wahoo Studios (developer of Outpost Kaloki X) and published by Namco Bandai. While the game was ultimately not released, a playable prototype of the game was made available in the Internet since December 2022.

454812.overview: Following a decade of research, the Free Radical Archive was able to find and release a new build of Star Wars: Battlefront III. This build, made in the final week of development, is full of content that has not been seen before by fans. The build is dated one week prior to the game's cancellation.

457309.overview:
The brothers are back on another adventure!

Released by Mr. Brocoli, creator of the Super Mario Galaxy Multiplayer hack, this hack allows two players to play Super Mario Galaxy 2 as a splitscreen adventure.

459939.overview: This is a 3D reimagining of Super Mario 63. Featuring a Custom Hubworld, over 30 Galaxies to explore, 60 Shine Sprites and 120 Star Coins to find!

461055.overview: SSB Alternate Universe is an alternative take on the third installment of the Super Smash Bros. franchise that features redesigned fighter movesets, edited stage environments, revamped gameplay, new mechanics, improved single player modes, and online functionality The mod can be run using Dolphin Emulator and it's also console compatible.

462216.overview: Super Smash REX is the spiritual successor to PMEX REMIX, reviving and expanding upon the legacy of the project. The mod builds on Project+, delivering new characters, fresh features, and the Ultimate Experience fans deserve—bringing dream fighters to life that may never make it into official Smash.

463769.overview:
If you've heard of PMEX Remix, Cobalt X (pronounced Cobalt Cross) is a similar project - in fact, it's a similar project to several other popular brawl mods that've popped up over the years, and that's by design: we're a crossover game built up by the contributions of many gracious modders over the years, and you've probably already seen some of our work intermingling with that of others.

What sets Cobalt apart, though, is that our team draws a sharper focus on competitive gameplay and visual quality over quantity: our goals are closer to that of P+... but with some flair.

Cobalt X v0.99 features Blaziken's premier as a completed character, a vastly expanded stagelist, massive soundtrack, and that's not even to mention its roster of characters - several of our fighters are designed from the ground up, so dont be afraid to experiment with characters you might've already tried in other games! That said, the P+ roster has remained largely the same as what you'll find in version 2.4.2... or at least, at first glance. Try holding L!

We've got secret boss characters, fun taunts, easter eggs, loads of new mechanics to play with... and Lyn.

465403.overview:
Wii Virtual Console version of a Neo Geo MVS, originally released in 1991.

This is not your typical baseball game. In the near future, there are two leagues with a total of twelve teams the player can choose from; pick your team and go for the championship. The games are held at the exclusive Cyber Egg Stadium, where the home run zone is alarmingly small and the fair zone is unusually wide. There is even a stop zone, stopping any ball that lands here.

As the game progresses, Crackers (mines) are installed. Armour can be purchased during games, to reinforce your players. All this makes for a unique baseball experience. You may be a bit perplexed at first, but once you get used to it and begin devising a strategy, you might even start enjoying all the curveballs being thrown at you.

Also in other consoles: Neo Geo AES, Neo Geo CD, Genesis/Mega Drive, Super NES
